newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas sells assets to Publicis.
newsitem.headline: Havas sells assets to Publicis.

text.p: French media and communications group Havas said in a statement that it had signed a deal with advertising, direct marketing and PR firm Publicis under which it will sell its 50 percent stake in Metrobus and 33.3 percent in Mediavision.
A Havas spokesman said the operation would generate a capital gain of some 80 million francs ($13.6 million).
The sale fits with Havas' strategy of disposing of minority stakes. Metrobus manages the advertising on the Paris metro system and buses with 1996 sales of 852 million francs.
Mediavision is France's leading broker of advertising space in cinemas and had 1996 sales of 169 million francs.
